name: NGC 1375 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 1375, a lenticular galaxy in the Fornax Cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc1375-hubble
story: NGC 1375 is a peculiar lenticular galaxy that seems to have fallen into the Fornax Cluster only recently. Among those recent arrivals, it is the only one of its kind still showing glowing gas.

claims.text: NGC 1375 is in the Fornax Cluster
FCC 148 is a peculiar S0 among the cluster's recent infallers
Among recent infallers, FCC 148 is the only early-type galaxy showing ionised-gas emission
